newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai bourse to begin move to Pudong in August.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai bourse to begin move to Pudong in August.

text.p: The Shanghai Stock Exchange would begin to move to the Pudong New Area east of Shanghai's Huangpu River in August, the Shanghai Securities News said on Wednesday.

In a announcement to its members, the exchange said the move would begin with each member recommending a few traders to do business on the trading floor of the exchange's new building in Pudong by August, the newspaper said.
Members can recommend as many traders as the number of trading seats they have on the exchange, the newspaper quoted the exchange announcement as saying.
After the first batch of the traders begin trading on the new floor and if business goes smoothly, other traders would be moved to the new venue as well, the announcement said.
It did not give a deadline for the whole exchange to move to Pudong.
Shanghai began to build the $148-million, 27-storey new exchange building in Pudong's Lujiazui Finance and Trade Zone two years ago due to the rapid development of its business.
The move is also in line with China's efforts to build the Lujiazui zone into China's major financial centre.
